body.x: A yard asks for different work in different seasons, from cutting grass in summer to clearing snow in winter. Each of those jobs usually calls for a separate tool.

Yarbo International Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Smart Home at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Yarbo M Series, a compact modular outdoor robotics platform designed for small to mid-sized yards.
Built around one universal core with interchangeable modules for mowing, trimming, snow removal and towing, the M Series enables year-round outdoor maintenance with fewer tools.

Compared with Yarbo's larger Y Series, it is optimized for standard residential environments. LiDAR-powered navigation, Data Center Gen2 and NetRTK service provide enhanced positioning and spatial awareness in tighter yard layouts.

Setup takes about 30 minutes, and wireless fast charging is up to three times faster than many conventional systems. The Yarbo Open Platform also lets users customize and expand new outdoor applications.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative. Yarbo M Series is at the Honoree level. Honorees can display their innovations at the CES Innovation Awards Showcase at the Venetian Expo, and the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) does not test or endorse the award-winning products.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.

Ahead of CES 2027, AVING NEWS will host the 3rd Innovation Awards Winners Networking Party at MIK BASE CAMP on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 p.m. The event will also feature individual video interviews with participating companies, with registration available through Eventus. In early December, AVING NEWS will begin its pre-show coverage, including an interview program connecting Korean innovators with U.S. media outlets that regularly cover CES and participate in the Innovation Awards judging process.
* AVING NEWS uses AI-assisted tools in its editorial process.
